positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Made registration code more resilient by adding redundancy to fallback to in the event of an outage
• Developed novel solution to issue that was causing a subset of users to get errantly blocked
• Fully owned the development and integration of new export compliance microservice for cloud
• Created monitors to alert engineers of issues in production and runbooks for resolving them
• Worked with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver a unified trial experience for cloud

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked on Alteryx rebranding of Trifacta pages and emails
• Created new configurations of Trifacta products for Alteryx rebranding
• Worked on authentication team to build new micro-frontends that handled login, registration, reset password, etc.
• Was integral to team's localization, logging, and telemetry efforts
• Made significant contributions to the Alteryx Analytics Cloud registration experience
• Tasked with initiative of improving export compliance system

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented user onboarding feature that provided new users with sample datasets and example flows
• Developed job result previews
• Worked on team for the experimental Input Data Configuration feature

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Worked on team to develop the Program By Example feature
• Prototyped a new column selection search experience using React

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Developed a full stack feature which allows users to control the format of exported CSV files
• Implemented a backend improvement that decoupled the monitoring and execution of Spark jobs, which increased the reliability and flexibility of Spark jobs overall

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: • Assisted in development of hardware sensor and mobile applications used to detect earthquakes
